sub_sector.value: ethylene production from ethane; midstream-style chemical MLP

manufacturing_type.detail: Continuous conversion of ethane into ethylene at production facilities.

production_model.detail: Continuous ethylene production sold under long-term supply agreements, moved by pipeline.

product_complexity.detail: Ethylene is a standard building-block commodity chemical.

production_role.detail: Supplies ethylene feedstock for polyethylene and PVC derivatives.

end_market_exposure.detail: Ethylene feeds polyethylene and PVC used in packaging, construction and transportation.

notes: Sales are largely to the parent Westlake under long-term fee-based agreements, from prior knowledge.
